content:
The image shows a green leaf with several irregular-shaped lesions. These lesions are dark brown to black, somewhat sunken, and have a necrotic, dried appearance, particularly at the leaf tip and along the edges. This pattern of dark, sunken spots is highly characteristic of Anthracnose. The lesions are distinct spots and some are causing die-back at the leaf tip, but the primary symptom is the spotted lesion. It is not a powdery or sooty coating.
